elements.description:
What an assistant remembers – grouped memories with filters, search, in-place editing, pause, forget with Undo, and
a master switch.

properties.name: memories
properties.description: The memories shown, grouped by their category

properties.name: categories
properties.description: Order of the groups and the choices for new memories – defaults to the categories in the order they appear

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Height of the list before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: undoFor
properties.description:
How long Undo stays on the tray (Clean: in the card's last row), in ms. It waits while the pointer or focus is on
the tray and starts over after; `Infinity` keeps it until the next forget (WCAG 2.2.1)

properties.name: addedSource
properties.description: Source given to memories added here

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: A button on the tray that fires tc-action – Undo takes its place for a moment

properties.name: onAdd
properties.description: Called with a memory added here

properties.name: onEdit
properties.description: Called when a memory's text was edited

properties.name: onPause
properties.description: Called when a memory was paused or resumed

properties.name: onForget
properties.description: Called when a memory was forgotten

properties.name: onRestore
properties.description: Called when a forgotten memory is brought back with Undo

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-memories-change
events.description: The list changed (added, edited, paused, forgotten, restored or rolled back); detail `{ memories: Memory[] }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the change out until the app passes the list back.

events.name: tc-enabled-change
events.description: The master switch was flipped; detail `{ enabled: boolean }`. Cancelable.

props.name: memories
props.description:
The memories (controlled): the panel shows exactly these and asks for changes through onChange. Leave it
undefined to let the panel keep the list, starting at `defaultMemories`

props.name: defaultMemories
props.description: The memories to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the full list after any change – in both modes

props.name: enabled
props.description: The master switch – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultEnabled
props.description: The master switch to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called when the master switch is flipped – in both modes

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the group's name

props.name: action
props.description: A button on the tray, e.g. { label: "Manage", onClick } – Undo takes its place for a moment
